title: Yuto Nagatomo Makes History as First Asian Player in Five FIFA World Cups
summary: Japanese footballer Yuto Nagatomo has achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first Asian player to participate in five FIFA World Cups. The 39-year-old defender's career, which began in 2010, reached its fifth World Cup appearance at the 2026 tournament. This achievement highlights his enduring dedication and fitness.
summary_points: Yuto Nagatomo is the first Asian player to feature in five FIFA World Cups.
The Japanese defender achieved this milestone at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Nagatomo's World Cup journey began in 2010.
His achievement is attributed to his dedication and fitness.
